source: 632 Conspiracy
target: 632 Coniuratio

source: Late at night, in Trier, Angoulême de François sat in front of a small analyzer and a radio transceiver, attentively listening to the clicks and observing as a “translated” telegram was produced by a mechanical typewriter.
target: Nocte sero, Treveris, Angoulême de François ante parvum analysatorem et radiotransmissorem sedebat, diligenter crepitus auscultans et intuens dum telegramma “translatum” per typographum mechanicum conficiebatur.

source: The signature above simply read Hidden Blade.
target: Subscriptio superna simpliciter legebatur “Hidden Blade.”

source: Having exchanged a few messages, Angoulême remained composed.
target: Paucis nuntiis commutatis, Angoulême constanter mansit.

source: He picked up the telegram and swiftly skimmed through its contents.
target: Telegramma sustulit et celeriter eius contenta percurrit.

source: “Um, when you’re protecting high-ranking government officials and members of parliament daily, do you tail them even during personal moments like affairs or trips to the washroom?”
target: “Um, cum quotidie officiales summi gradus gubernii et parlamentarios protegis, an eos etiam in momentis privatis, ut in amatoriis aut itineribus ad latrinam, insequeris?”

source: A wry smile formed on Angoulême’s face.
target: Risus sardonicus in vultu Angoulême apparuit.

source: He contemplated responding to Hidden Blade with, “What occupies your thoughts all day?” However, in the blink of an eye, his eyes narrowed as he tapped away on the mechanical typewriter.
target: Cogitavit Hidden Blade respondere, “Quid totum diem cogitationes tuas occupant?” Attamen, in momento oculi eius adstricti sunt, dum typografo mechanico celeriter pulsaret.

source: “Tell me, what crime do you intend to commit? Which high-ranking government official or member of parliament is your target for assassination?”
target: “Dic mihi, quid scelus committere intendis? Quem officialem summi gradus sive membrum parlamenti interficere destinaveris?”

source: Dammit! Franca, seated in the master bedroom of her apartment, squirmed uncomfortably.
target: Heu! Franca, in camera principali domus suae sedens, incommode se contorquebat.

source: Why did it feel like she was undergoing police interrogation?
target: Cur videbatur quasi a custodibus vigilum interrogaretur?

source: She dryly chuckled to herself and replied on the mechanical typewriter.
target: Illa ad seipsam siccare risit et in typografo mechanico respondit.

source: “I’m just curious. Following them would be awkward, and not doing so might expose a security vulnerability easily exploitable by others.”
target: “Modo curiosa sum. Eos sequi incommode esset, et non faciens vulnerabilitas securitatis, quam ceteri facile adhibere possent, pateficaretur.”

source: She refused to acknowledge any plans involving the Minister of Industry in the current government.
target: Illa consilia quae Minister Industriae in regimine hodierno implicabantur agnoscere recusavit.

source: After a while, 007 sent a new telegram.
target: Post aliquod tempus, 007 novum telegramma misit.

source: “I rarely undertake such missions.
target: “Raro tales missiones suscipio.”

source: Initially, I dealt with Beyonder incidents and battled cultists.
target: Initio casibus Beyonder versatus sum et cultores pugnavi.

source: Later, I got promoted and no longer had to participate in daily protection operations.
target: Postea, promotus sum et iam non opus erat me in operibus quotidianis protectionis participare.

source: “Based on my knowledge and limited experience, we have to follow the protectee wherever they go.
target: “Ex scientia mea et parva experientia, protectum ubicumque vadit, sequi debemus.

source: If they choose to have an affair, at least one of us will discreetly stand by the coat rack, keeping a watchful eye.
target: Si relationem amatoriam eligunt, saltem unus ex nobis tacite iuxta armarium vestimentorum stabit, ac vigilans perscrutabitur.

source: If time allows, we’ll investigate and confirm the identity and background of the target in advance.
target: Si tempus conceditur, indagationem faciemus et identitatem ac originem destinati praevidemus.

source: If the protectee enters the washroom, one of us waits by their side, guarding against potential threats from sewers, ventilation pipes, and shadows.
target: Si protectus latrinam ingreditur, unus ex nobis iuxta eum exspectat, ad tuendas minas ex cloacis, fistulis ventilationis, et umbris.

source: However, there’s an exception.
target: Attamen, est exceptio.

source: If the protectee strongly requests and writes an exemption, we can respect their privacy.
target: Si protectus vehementer petit et exemptionem scribit, intimitatem eius observare possumus.

source: After all, we’re not their parents obligated to protect their every move.
target: Quia non sumus parentes illorum, ad protegendum omne eorum motum obligati.

source: If they perish, someone else will take their place.
target: Si intereunt, aliquis alius locum eorum occupabit.

source: It’s not easy to find a three-legged toad, but those aspiring to be high-ranking government officials and members of parliament can fill Avenue du Boulevard.
target: Non facile est invenire bufonem tribipedalem, sed qui officiales summi gradus et parlamentarios fieri cupiunt, Avenue du Boulevard implere possunt.

source: Moreover, such officials and MPs don’t often possess exceptional foresight and wisdom.
target: Praeterea, tales officiales et parlamentarii non saepius eximiam providentiam et sapientiam habent.

source: What matters is the position they hold, not the individual.
target: Quod refert, munus quod tenent, non persona ipsa.

source: Very few high-ranking officials and MPs choose to write exemptions for privacy, but they tend to do so when discussing confidential matters with their team.
target: Pauci officiales summi gradus et parlamentarii exemptionem pro intimitate scribere malunt, sed id faciunt cum res arcana cum suo manipulo aguntur.

source: 007, did you work overtime so much that you harbor resentment? Franca chuckled inwardly.
target: 007, num ita plus operatus es ut animos iracundos haberes? Franca intime subridens risit.

source: She felt that 007 wasn’t as laid back as she would have liked.
target: Illa sensit 007 non esse tam tranquillum, quod ipsa optaverat.

source: If it were the two members from Loen, they would likely say, “It’s fine if most high-ranking officials who don’t deal with real matters or MPs who only give speeches are dead. Even curly-haired baboons in their positions would perform better. At least the baboons wouldn’t smack their heads to formulate policies or work for personal gain. They wouldn’t boast about their wisdom and desire to show off. They’d simply enjoy bananas and play happily. That’s the least harmful thing for the entire country.”
target: “Si duo ex membris Loen essent, verisimiliter dicerent: ‘Non refert si plerique officiales summi gradus, qui re vera non currunt, aut parlamentarii qui solum orationes habent, mortui sint. Etiam papiones capillis crispis in suis officiis melius se gerere possent. Saltem papiones capita sua non pulsarent ad consilia formanda aut utilitatem personalem quaerendam. Non gloriarentur de sapientia et ostentatione sua. Simpliciter bananas degustarent et laeti ludirent. Hoc est minimum nocivum pro tota re publica.’”

source: Franca read 007’s telegram again and turned to Jenna, who was sitting by the bed.
target: Franca iterum telegramma 007 legebat et ad Jennam, quae iuxta lectum sedebat, se convertit.

source: “The protective measures are tight, and there are no loopholes to exploit.”
target: “Mensurae tutelae strictae sunt, nec sunt lacunae ad expoliendum.”

source: “Yes, that’s the case with the Purifiers. The Machinery Hivemind and Bureau 8 should be similar.”
target: “Etiam, id valet pro Purificatoribus. Machina Hivemind et Bureau 8 similiter esse debent.”

source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony had been gathering information for a while and had devised several plans, but they still found it unsafe and uncertain.
target: Franca, Jenna, et Anthony aliquod tempus informationes colligebant ac plura consilia excogitaverant, sed ea adhuc incerta et periculosa videbantur.

source: Hence, they consulted 007, seeking clarification on the security situation around Moran Avigny.
target: Ergo 007 consuluerunt, statu securitatis circa Moran Avigny expositionem petentes.

source: Being a Cabinet Minister of a country, Moran Avigny was not an easy target for assassination.
target: Cum esset minister consilii patriae, Moran Avigny non facilis meta ad caedem erat.

source: Moreover, Franca and the others’ primary goal wasn’t assassination.
target: Praeterea, propositum principale Francae et ceterorum non erat caedes.

source: Even if they considered it, they had to factor in the time required for spirit channeling, making it even more troublesome.
target: Etiam, si id considerassent, tempus necessitatis canalizationis spiritus in rationem ducendum erat, quod rem magis molestam faciebat.

source: Listening to Franca’s summary of 007’s response, Jenna pondered for a moment and said, “If it were any other Demoness, they might choose to sacrifice their established legitimate identity by seducing Moran Avigny and pretending to be shy to make the minister get an exemption from the protectors. However, I don’t think that’s feasible. Moran Avigny is likely a Mirror Person, and Mirror People have a close relationship with the Demoness pathway. They might be especially wary of a Demoness approaching them.”
target: Auditae Francae compilationi responsionis a 007, Jenna paulisper meditata dixit: "Si alia Demonissa esset, forsitan statuta legitima identitas sua sacrificanda elegissent, seducendo Moran Avigny et simulans pudorem, ut minister exemptionem ab protectoribus obtineret. Tamen, id non puto esse possibile. Moran Avigny verisimiliter Persona Speculi est, et Personae Speculi arctam relationem cum via Demonissae habent. Forsitan maxime caveant ne Demonissa ad eos accedat."

source: Franca had initially hesitated to involve Jenna in the operation against Moran Avigny because the Demoness of Black Clarice would secretly monitor and provide assistance at critical moments.
target: Primum Franca conari dubitavit Jennam in operatione contra Moran Avigny implicare, quia Demonissa Nigrae Clarice occulte monitorem haberet atque in momentis crucialibus auxilium ferre posset.

source: It would be risky if she discovered Jenna using the Demoness pathway’s abilities.
target: Periculosum foret, si invenisset Jennam vires via Demonissae adhibere.

source: However, Jenna insisted on participating. Her reasoning was:
target: Tamen, Jenna in participatione pertinere statuit. Argumentum eius erat:

source: After Franca admitted to Clarice that she hadn’t experienced pleasure for a long time, the Demoness of Black would likely suspect her relationship with Franca.
target: Postquam Franca Clarice confessus est se diu voluptatem non expertam esse, Demonissa Nigrae verisimiliter eius relationem cum Franca suspicaretur.

source: After all, Franca had approached Browns Sauron under the guise of attending a female orgy.
target: Quia Franca, sub specie conviviae feminae, Browns Sauron adiit.

source: Therefore, Jenna wanted to showcase a Vampire’s abilities and combat style in front of the Demoness of Black.
target: Ergo, Jenna voluit virtutes et morem pugnae vampyri coram Demonissa Nigrae ostendere.

source: The mystical item she currently possessed would allow her to disguise herself effectively and maintain sufficient combat strength.
target: Res mystica quam nunc habet, ei licebat ut se efficaciter camufliceret et ad pugnandum satis robur retineret.

source: The prerequisite was that she had to conceal the Arrow of the Bloodthirsty well and hide it under her clothes.
target: Praerequisitum erat ut Sagittam Sanguinis Sitientis bene celaret et sub vestimentis absconderet.

source: As for Mirror Substitution, she could explain it away with Franca since Anthony had one too.
target: Quoad Substitutionem Speculi, eam cum Franca excusare poterat, nam et Anthony unam haberet.

source: Franca had muttered, “Demonesses can also have pure love,” but as she finished speaking, she awkwardly changed the topic and tacitly allowed Jenna to participate.
target: Franca submurmuravit, “Demonissae etiam amorem purum habere possunt,” sed loquendo finivit, et male congruenter rem mutavit atque tacite Jennam ad participandum concessit.

source: “Hmm.” Franca, sitting cross-legged, nodded slightly and said, “Moran Avigny’s strength is unknown. He might be very formidable. If we attempt to seduce him, we risk becoming his prey if he’s vigilant, possibly even losing our lives. Sigh, I’d better write to Lumian and see what he thinks.”
target: “Hmm.” Franca, in gremio sedens, leviter annuit et dixit, “Virtus Moran Avigny ignota est. Fortasse valde formidolosus sit. Si eum seducere conamur, periclitamur ut, si vigilat, praeda eius fiamus, forsitan etiam vitam amittamus. Heu, melius est mihi ad Lumian scribere et quid existimet cognoscere.”

source: Franca chuckled self-deprecatingly.
target: Franca seipsam demum subridens deridebat.

source: “Ever since he left Trier, my brain seems to have gone on vacation.”
target: “Ex quo Trier discessit, videtur cerebrum meum in ferias ivisse.”

source: She was mocking her past laziness, acknowledging that she often delegated the primary responsibility of thinking to Lumian while playing a supporting role.
target: Praeteritam ignaviam suam irridens agebat, agnoscens saepe primariam munus cogitandi Lumian delegasse, dum munus subveniendi ageret.

source: Jenna chuckled and said, “You’re really good at self-deprecating. That’s what I admire most about you. You’re open-minded and cheerful.”
target: Jenna subridens dixit, “Valde es bonus ad teipsum deprecandum; hoc maxime in te admiror. Es mente aperta et hilaris.”

source: Franca chuckled.
target: Franca risit.

source: “Teasing can liven up the atmosphere and foster closer relationships, but sometimes, if you can’t gauge others’ acceptance, teasing can easily turn into mockery. It’s safer to make a self-deprecating remark.”
target: “Ludibria possunt atmosphaeram animare et relationes intimas fovere, sed interdum, si aliorum receptio aestimari non potest, ludibria facile in derisum versari possunt. Melius est rem de seipsum deprecantem facere.”

source: As the two Demonesses conversed, a telegram clattered in. It was still from 007.
target: Dum duae Demonissae colloquebantur, telegramma strepitu pervenit. Id adhuc a 007 erat.

source: Franca’s eyes lit up as she read the telegram.
target: Oculi Francae fulserunt dum telegramma legebat.

source: The telegram read:
target: Telegramma dicebat:

source: “Hidden Blade, if you disclose your target and provide sufficient reason, I might be able to offer assistance and discreetly cooperate with your actions.”
target: “Hidden Blade, si destinatum tuum revelaveris et causam satis praebueris, forsitan auxilium ferre et occultam cooperationem cum tuis actibus praebere possim.”

source: Wow, what a bro! Franca praised inwardly as her fingers swiftly moved over the mechanical typewriter.
target: “O, quid egregium, care frater! Franca intime laudes sussurravit, dum digiti eius celeriter per typographum mechanicum laborabant.”

source: “Here’s the deal. I currently possess ample evidence to believe that the Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny, is a Mirror Person who has infiltrated Trier and assumed the original owner’s identity for decades. Haha, I didn’t reveal this earlier because I needed to acquire crucial information from Moran Avigny. If he’s captured by you, I can’t guarantee that you’ll gain access to pertinent information, so I plan to take action myself.”
target: “Ecce, res est. Nunc habeo amplas probationes quo crederem Ministrum Industriae, Moran Avigny, esse Personam Speculi, qui Treverim infiltravit et identitatem pristini possessoris per decennia assumpsit. Haha, hoc ante non revelavi, quod necessarium erat mihi ad informationes maximi momenti a Moran Avigny acquirendas. Si a te capitur, non possum tibi certitudinem dare ut ad informationes pertinentes pervenias, ideo ipse consilium capere cogito.”

source: “Phew… There’s hope!” Franca turned around and joyfully raised her right index and middle fingers to Jenna.
target: “Phew… Spes est!” Franca se versa laetissime dexteros digitos indicem et medius ad Jennam extulit.

source: Before long, 007 responded:
target: Non longe post, 007 respondit:

source: “Gather the results of your previous investigations and Moran Avigny’s information promptly and place it at the designated contact point. I’ll verify it first and find an opportune moment. Await my further instructions.”
target: “Collige eventus investigationum tuarum priores atque informationes de Moran Avigny celeriter, et pone ea in loco destinato contactui. Ego ea primum verificabo et opportunum momentum inveniendum quaesiverim. Exspecta ulteriores instructiones meas.”

source: Franca’s face lit up with joy. She pursed her lips and sent a brief telegram:
target: Vultus Francae laetitia effulgebat. Labris contritis brevem telegramma misit.

source: “It’s highly likely that a demigod of the Demoness Sect will be involved in this operation. Exercise caution.”
target: “Probabiliter demidivus ex Secta Demonissae hoc in consilio implicabitur. Cave.”

source: Jenna read it quietly and asked thoughtfully, “Are we still seeking Lumian’s opinion?”
target: Jenna id quiete legebat et cogitabunda interrogavit: “Num adhuc opinionem Lumian petimus?”

source: “Yes,” Franca replied without hesitation. “As the saying goes, ‘three smelly cobblers are as good as Roselle.’ With more people brainstorming, we may uncover better solutions.”
target: “Ita,” Franca respondit sine mora. “Ut dicitur, ‘tria calceolarii foetidi aeque valent ac Roselle.’ Cum pluribus cogitandis, meliora consilia invenire possumus.”

source: “What kind of proverb is that? Why haven’t I heard it before…” Jenna suspected that Franca was making it up.
target: “Quale proverbium est hoc? Cur numquam prius audivi…?” Jenna suspicabatur Francam hoc fingere.

source: The crimson moon remained unseen, with only the stars casting a faint glow.
target: Luna coccinea non visa est, solis stellis leviter nitentibus tantum.

source: Seated in the Berries’ first-class suite, Lumian perused Dutanese textbooks when his messenger, Penitent Baynfel, abruptly materialized before him.
target: Sedens in conclavi primae classis Berries, Lumian libros Dutanenses perlegebat, cum nuntius eius, Penitent Baynfel, subito ante eum apparuit.

source: Baynfel, draped in a black clergyman’s robe, resembling a charred corpse, handed over the letter.
target: Baynfel, in veste nigra clericali indutus, cadaver comburitum quasi similis, epistulam tradidit.

source: Lumian caught it, inhaling the lingering fragrance on the paper.
target: Lumian eam arripuit, fragranti residuo in charta percepto.

source: Franca’s letter… Jenna even held and read it… Lumian made a casual judgment as he observed his messenger curiously.
target: Epistula Francae… Jenna etiam eam tenuit et legebat… Lumian iudicium leviter fecit, dum nuntium suum curiose contemplabatur.

source: He had a persistent feeling that Penitent Baynfel harbored many untold stories, but every attempt to engage in conversation was met with stoic silence.
target: Persistens sensus eum afficiebat, Penitent Baynfel multarum fabularum inauditarum recondere, sed omnis conatus colloquii in silentio stoeico evanescere.

source: After Baynfel traversed into the spirit world, Lumian unfolded the letter, reclined in his chair, and leisurely read.
target: Postquam Baynfel in mundum spirituum transeunxit, Lumian epistulam explicavit, in sella recubuit, et lente legere coepit.

source: With 007’s help, this shouldn’t be difficult.
target: Auxilio 007, hoc non difficile erit.

source: Lumian smiled suddenly and whispered to himself, If it doesn’t work out, they can force the bait.
target: Lumian subito subridens sibi sussurravit: “Si non procedat, insidiam coacta facere possunt.”

source: Focus on the Mirror Person’s wariness of Demonesses and the potential strength they possess to lure him.
target: Attende ad cautelam Personae Speculi erga Demonissas et ad potentiam quam habent ad eum allicendum.

source: When Moran Avigny believes the target is a bait from the Demoness Sect, with a demigod hiding behind her, planning to take the poison pill and retreat to deliver a bomb, he’ll find himself facing one or two Angels, three to five demigods…
target: Quando Moran Avigny putabit destinatum esse insidiam ex Secta Demonissae, cum demidivus post eam absconditus sit, qui pillam venenatam sumere et recedere ad bombam inferendam consilium facit, inveniet se oppositum uno aut duobus Angelis, tribus ad quinque demideis.

source: However, this way, Franca’s Demoness Sect mission will be finished…
target: At hoc modo, missio Sectae Demonissae Francae confecta erit…

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he crafted and discarded one plan after another.
target: Cogitationes Luminum succurrentes erant, dum unum consilium post aliud excogitabat et deiciebat.

source: Tomorrow, the Berries would depart from the Berserk Sea, sailing into the Southern Continent’s waters.
target: Cras, Berries ab Oceano Furioso discedent, navigantes ad aquas Continenti Australis.

source: When the time came, the ship wouldn’t need to navigate complex twists and turns to avoid storms, maelstroms, and mystical phenomena. It could head directly for its destination port in West Balam.
target: Cum tempus advenisset, navis non oportuit circumire angulares flexus ad tempestates, maelstromata, et phaenomena mystica vitanda. Potuit directe ad portum destinatum in Occidente Balam progredi.

source: Suddenly, Lumian sensed something and stood up.
target: Subito, Lumian aliquid sensit et surrexit.

source: Approaching the window, he peered out. In the darkness not far away, an ancient three-masted sailboat sailed silently.
target: Accedens ad fenestram, extrinsecus contemplatus est. In obscuritate non longe, vetus navis tribus mythris silentio vecta est.

source: There were no lights on the ship, and no one strolled on the deck.
target: In nave nullae luces erant, nec quisquam in ponte ambulabat.
